Name: JP's Keybind Menu
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[center][b][color=#00ff00][size=6][font=Georgia][i][u]Keybind Menu[/u][/i][/font][/size][/color][/b][/center]


[b][font=Georgia][i][color=#ff00ff][size=5]You have everything in one place, it couldn't be easier![/size][/color][/i][/font][/b]


[size=4][b][font=Georgia]A simple menu that can come to your rescue when it comes to Android settings. It's hard to access game or mod files because of those silly restrictions... Not anymore. [/font][/b][/size]

[size=4][b][font=Georgia]It also works great on a PC. Using the [color=#00ffff]M key or the floating button that you can move wherever you like[/color], you can access this menu, which you can customize in GMCM to include shortcuts to the mods that interest you most. [/font][/b][/size]


[b][font=Georgia][color=#00ff00][size=5][i]Now you don't need to configure anything; you can even access mods that share the same activation key. Don't forget about GMCM, it'll make your life easier. [/i][/size][/color][/font][/b]


[b][font=Georgia][i][u][color=#ffff00][size=5]Translations[/size][/color][/u][/i]
[size=4]You are free to translate the mod; [color=#ff0000]you don't need to ask my permission.[/color][/size]
[size=4]You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods.[/size]
[size=4]If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there. [/size]

Downloads.Description:
Unzip and install like any other mod. If you like the mod don't forget to hit the 'Endorse' button at the top of this page, it helps me a lot and it's free :D

Be sure to stop by later, you're important to me <3
